data.name: Agentic Web
data.summary: GO MO Group builds a machine-facing 'agentic web' layer on a company's existing domain so AI assistants and agentic browsers can read, cite and act on its business information. The layer has six components: an /agent page, llms.txt, schema.org structured data, a /.well-known API catalogue, a read-only public REST API and an MCP server. A standard build runs about three weeks (audit, build, deploy, verify) and is followed by optional monthly sync; the existing human website is not rebuilt.
data.summary_sv: Den agentiska webben är det maskininriktade lagret av din webbplats – ditt företag som strukturerad data som AI-assistenter och agentiska webbläsare kan läsa, citera och agera utifrån. GO MO bygger lagret på er egen domän, bredvid den befintliga webbplatsen.
key_points: Six components: agent page (/agent), llms.txt, schema.org structured data, API catalogue (/.well-known), public read-only REST API (/api/v1) and MCP server (/mcp)
Four-step delivery in about three weeks: audit, build, deploy on the client's own domain (robots.txt and ai.txt permissions set), verify and keep in sync monthly

Measured three ways: Lighthouse/PageSpeed Insights 'Agentic Browsing' category (score out of 3), independent audits by Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and Perplexity, and a live MCP test where an agent submits an enquiry with user consent
First Swedish B2B build: Agentic Browsing 1/3 to 3/3, 5/5 AI platforms rated it agent-friendly, 2/2 agent-submitted leads delivered via MCP, 8+/10 average LLM answer rating
Google's share of search fell to 75.5% (Statcounter, 2020 vs 2026)
53% of web traffic is no longer human (Imperva Bad Bot Report, 2026)
Almost no competitor in industrial B2B has a machine-readable layer today (GO MO Group, market review)
No website rebuild required: the layer is added alongside the existing site on the same domain

tiers.name: Full agentic web build
tiers.includes: Audit included, six components live, about three weeks (marked 'Most chosen')
